title: Vikram and Betal: The Careless Worker
moral: Careful work leads to better results.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a careless worker.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a worker who rushed his work.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The worker finished quickly but made mistakes.
scenes.image_prompt: worker making mistakes while working fast cartoon

scenes.text: Another worker completed the task slowly and correctly.
The master praised the careful worker.
The worker learned to work carefully. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A careless worker made mistakes by rushing, while another succeeded by being careful. Vikram said careful work is better than quick work.
